body.text: SEO services are the ongoing work of improving a website so it ranks higher in Google and is cited in AI answers. Teknoppy, a Kochi-based SEO agency since 2018, delivers a technical audit, on-page fixes, content, local SEO and link building, reported monthly. Most clients see movement in 3 to 6 months.
Founded 2018 | Based in Vyttila, Kochi | Plans from Rs. 15,000/month | First movement in 3-6 months | Monthly reporting.
We also advise in-house teams, founders and agencies that need a specialist partner — with every campaign tied to qualified organic enquiries, calls and sales.

paragraphs.html:
Real SEO services are more than a monthly blog post and a backlink report. A complete engagement covers:

• SEO strategy and keyword research: what to target, and why.
• Technical SEO: crawlability, indexing and site health.
• On-page optimization: titles, headings, content and schema.
• Content SEO: pages and articles built around real search questions.
• Speed and Core Web Vitals: faster pages, better page experience.
• Link building: earned links that build durable authority.

paragraphs.text: Search behavior keeps splitting across more surfaces than a single Google results page — AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity now answer questions that used to send a click to a website. SEO services in 2026 have to plan for both: rankings in traditional search, and citability in AI-generated answers. A site that only optimizes for the old model is already behind on the newer one, even if last year's tactics still technically "work."

items.a: A complete engagement covers technical SEO, on-page optimization, content and keyword strategy, link building, and monthly reporting — not just one of these sold alone as 'SEO'.

items.q: How much do SEO services cost?
items.a: Most businesses invest between Rs. 15,000 and Rs. 75,000 per month depending on competition and scope; enterprise engagements run higher. A written quote is shared before work starts.

items.q: How long do SEO services take to show results?
items.a: Most clients see meaningful movement within 3 to 6 months, with gains compounding over the following months rather than resetting each cycle.

items.q: Which SEO provider is right for my business?
items.a: The right fit depends on your industry, budget and current site health. That is why every Teknoppy engagement starts with an audit: it shows what to fix first and what results are realistic.

items.q: What is the difference between SEO services and SEO consulting?
items.a: SEO services mean we execute the work directly — audits, fixes, content, links. SEO consulting services mean we advise your existing team on strategy while your staff implements it.

No. Google controls rankings, so no ethical agency can guarantee them. We commit to a written scope, monthly reporting and work tied to keywords and pages that can move. Most clients see movement within 3 to 6 months.

items.q: Does Teknoppy offer SEO services in Kochi?
items.a: Yes. Teknoppy is based in Vyttila, Kochi, and delivers SEO services for businesses in Kochi, across Kerala and in the GCC. Remote clients get reporting calls at a time that suits their time zone.

items.q: What do I get in the first 90 days of SEO?
items.a: Month 1 covers the audit, keyword mapping and a written roadmap. Months 2 and 3 focus on technical fixes, on-page updates and content. Ranking movement usually starts between months 3 and 6.
A plain-English monthly report and a review call covering what was done, what moved and why. It tracks rankings, organic traffic and enquiries, not just impressions.

items.q: Do SEO services also help with AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity?
items.a: Yes. Alongside traditional Google rankings, we structure content and schema for AEO and GEO, since SEO services that also optimize for AI answer engines are increasingly what separates a modern agency from a legacy one.
